label: Overview
title: VERSEVA Design: tokens, components and widgets
description: VERSEVA Design: an open design system with tokens, components, widgets, motion and an asset library. MIT licensed on npm as @verseva/design.

label: Foundations
title: Foundations: color, type, radius and motion tokens
description: Every token in the signature: color ladders, status, data colors, glass material, radius and spacing, type, motion and live contrast ratios.

label: Asset Library
title: Asset Library: 3D objects and loops
description: Open 3D objects and motion loops, themed to the signature, ready to download and drop into a surface.

label: Widgets
title: Widgets: home screen widgets in four sizes
description: Home screen widgets in small, medium, large and extra large, each size with its own chart. Smart stacks, edit mode and drag to reorder.

label: Components
title: Components: buttons, fields, cards and the console shell
description: Buttons, fields, checkboxes, cards, glass panels, badges and the console shell, each with every state: hover, focus, press, disabled and loading.

label: Web UI
title: Web UI: ladders, type and contract specimens
description: The color ladders, the type trio, radius and press behavior, and the contract specimens every web surface is built from.

label: Data viz
title: Data viz: stat tiles, sparklines, bars and rings
description: Stat tiles, sparklines, line and area charts, bars, stacked segments, calendars and rings, drawn from the data color tokens.

label: Motion
title: Motion: easing, press, entrances and number tweens
description: Motion tokens and recipes: press, entrances, line reveal, spotlight, magnetic, number tweens and text swaps. Reduced motion respected.

label: Decks
title: Decks: slide anatomy and structure
description: Slide anatomy and deck structure on the VERSEVA signature, for presentations that match the product.

label: Docs and PDF
title: Docs and PDF: memo anatomy
description: Memo and document anatomy for docs and PDFs on the VERSEVA signature.

label: Distribute
title: Distribute: npm, registries, agents and themes
description: Install from npm, copy parts with npx verseva add, use the registry with coding agents, and apply theme presets.

label: Gallery
title: Gallery: example sites and apps built on VERSEVA Design
description: Example consoles, landing pages, stores and tools built on VERSEVA Design, with the source for each.
